definitions.explanation: A ceremonial head ornament worn by royalty or nobility.
The top part of the head.
The upper component of a kanji character.

examples.japanese: ⟦{王様|おうさま}→王様：01902_ousama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{金|きん}→金：02666_kin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{冠|かんむり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶっている→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧。
examples.english: The king wears a golden crown.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{冠|かんむり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「うかんむり」⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The crown radical of this kanji is 'ukanmuri'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月桂冠|げっけいかん}→月桂冠：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}せた→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧。
examples.english: They placed a laurel wreath on their head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勝者|しょうしゃ}→勝者：15630_shousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{月桂樹|げっけいじゅ}→月桂樹：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{冠|かんむり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{授|さず}けられた→授ける：10350_sazukeru⟧。
examples.english: The winner was awarded a laurel crown.

examples.japanese: {冠|かんむり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦あたり→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: The top of my head hurts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{冠|かんむり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ちょこんと→ちょこんと：noentry⟧⟦{載|の}せている→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧。
examples.english: She has a hat perched on the top of her head.

examples.japanese: {冠|かんむり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}くなってきた→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{気|き}にしている→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧。
examples.english: He's worried about the hair on his crown thinning.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{宇|う}→宇：noentry⟧」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦うかんむり→うかんむり：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れないで→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: Don't forget the dot when writing the ukanmuri radical in 宇.

examples.japanese: {冠|かんむり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧でも、⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}えば→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Even if the crown radical is the same, the meaning changes if the bottom part is different.

notes:
{冠|かんむり} can refer to crowns, wreaths, or the top radical of kanji characters.

KANJI RADICALS:
In kanji terminology, {冠|かんむり} refers to the component on top of a character. Common ones include:
- うかんむり ({宀|うかんむり}): ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧, ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧, ⟦{宝|たから}→宝：03401_takara⟧
- ⟦くさかんむり→くさかんむり：27337_kusakanmuri⟧ ({艹|くさかんむり}): ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧, ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧, ⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧
- あめかんむり ({雨|あめかんむり}): ⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧, ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧, {電|でん}
- たけかんむり ({竹|たけかんむり}): ⟦{筆|ふで}→筆：03601_fude⟧, ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧, ⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{王冠|おうかん}→王冠：15932_oukan⟧ (royal crown)
- ⟦{月桂冠|げっけいかん}→月桂冠：noentry⟧ (laurel wreath)
